scope: Authorized repair of 38 damaged selected-version source hrefs in 13 existing published fairy-tale pages, plus 26 URL-tail spill removals. apply_patch also added a single missing terminal LF to each of those 13 HTML files, explicitly accepted and recorded separately. No argument, translation, selected-version prose, route, index, controller, schema or analytics rewrite.
canonical_source: Current complete published Chinese HTML, not original external Markdown and not abbreviated existing English.

root_cause.before: Both regexes used https?://[^)]+ and stopped at the first URL-internal closing parenthesis. inline_markdown left the remaining URL tail outside the anchor; source_copy passed an already-truncated first URL to the short English note, which therefore had no visible spill.
root_cause.fix: One balanced-parenthesis source-link scanner is used by both functions. Rendering escapes text, label and complete href separately. Malformed/unbalanced links remain visible instead of producing incomplete anchors. No importer render or old Markdown reconstruction performed.
